about: Qlick Lab's design tokens: the one place the lab's colours, shapes, motion and capital labels are written. Design/ThemeTokens.swift is generated from this file by DesignTokensTests (QLICK_UPDATE_GENERATED=1 swift test --filter DesignTokensTests). The colours are QLab's (its Theme: black 0, surface 0.07, raised 0.115, hairline 0.2, faint 0.32, dim 0.5, text 0.94, neutral greys) and its red, Display P3 0.89, 0.11, 0.14, with its sRGB equivalent for AppKit and the contrast checks.

colours.name: bg
colours.doc: The sheet the photograph lies on (canvas, grid).

colours.name: panel
colours.doc: The inspector and the lab's surfaces, a shade lighter than the sheet; also the alert sheet.

colours.name: film
colours.doc: The film's black: the strip, the tray, the leader, the contact sheet.

colours.name: track
colours.doc: Slider track, outlines, separators, outlined buttons. Only on things whose words or shape already say what they are.

colours.name: faint
colours.doc: The faintest words and marks: disabled hints, empty states.

colours.name: dim
colours.doc: Values at their default, hints, secondary words, capital labels.

colours.name: paper
colours.doc: What's being read: names, changed values, the focus box.

colours.name: accent
colours.doc: The lab's red, the pencil: the active, the selected, the main action. Never decoration. The sRGB value is the Display P3 red brought into sRGB.

colours.name: warn
colours.doc: Errors and warnings, always as words.

colours.name: raised
colours.doc: A raised surface: a disabled main button, a lifted card.

radii.name: control
radii.doc: A button, a tile, a settings row.

radii.name: thumbnail
radii.doc: A recipe's thumbnail, an icon button.

motion.name: springDamping
motion.doc: The spring's damping fraction: no bounce.

caps.name: size
caps.doc: A capital label's size, in points (medium weight).

caps.name: tracking
caps.doc: A capital label's letter spacing, times its size.
